name: Attune Magic Device
body:
You have a knack for using magic items.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 5 ranks, Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit: When you successfully activate an item with the Use Magic Device skill, you may attune yourself to the item as a free action. For the next 24 hours, You do not need to make Use Magic Device checks to activate that item. You can attune yourself to only one item at a time. If you attune yourself to a second item, the previous attunement ends.
